intent: Eight original cooperation tasks construct planning-to-check sequence, match opposite responsibility stations, separate internal checking from public sharing, assign fact checking, connect delay notification to adjustment, respect several necessary contributions and read a two-part meeting requirement. Fresh podcast transfer changes all people and the check day and rejects task inflation and automatic publication.
picturePurpose: Original permission clipboard versus microphone/script identifies two preparation stations; code labels them. The picture establishes neither granted permission, completed recording nor readiness for public sharing.

workshop.title: 分清职责，排好合作流程
workshop.instruction: 把规划到检查的步骤排出来，再逐项核对谁负责什么、检查的用途和分享条件。

items.label: 把合作流程排出来
items.prompt: Arrange the agreed steps from planning to the first group check.
items.answer: List visitor needs → divide the work → check the guide together.
items.reason: First先列访客需要，Next再分工；完成各自任务后，才一起检查。功劳不全归朗读者是贡献评价，不属于这三个行动步骤。
items.hint: First和Next给出前两步；After doing our separate jobs说明共同检查在各自工作之后。
items.material:
MAKING AN AUDIO GUIDE TOGETHER
Our team is making a short audio guide to the school art display.
First, we listed what visitors would need to know about each artwork.
Next, we divided the work among our team.
Jia will ask each maker for permission and record the answer on a clipboard.
Ben will check the words and facts in the script.
Lin will practise reading the script at the microphone.
After doing our separate jobs, we will check the guide together on Thursday afternoon.
Thursday is our first group check, not a public release.
We will share the guide only after checking the corrections and getting the makers' permission.
If a part will be late, its owner should tell the team early.
That gives us time to adjust the work together.
The reader will not receive all the credit.
Accurate information, permission and testing matter too.
At the next meeting, each person should bring one completed part and one question.

items.label: 内部检查不是公开发布
items.prompt: Does the Thursday check mean the guide can already be shared publicly?

items.reason: Thursday只是首次组内检查；公开分享还须核对修改并取得作者许可。不能把日程上的检查点直接当成已承诺的发布时间。

transfer.passage:
A CLASS EXHIBITION PODCAST
Our team will first list the information listeners need. Next, we will divide the jobs. Ava will ask the makers for permission, Omar will check the facts, and Rui will practise the introduction. After these jobs, we will meet on Tuesday for a first check. Tuesday is not a promised public release. The podcast will be shared only after corrections have been checked and the makers have given permission. If a part will be late, its owner should tell the group early so that we can adjust the plan.

options.text: Rui asks for permission because practising the introduction gives him every job.
The podcast must be released publicly on Tuesday, even if permission is still unchecked.
Ava handles permission, Tuesday is a first check, and a likely delay should be reported early.

answer.display: Ava handles permission, Tuesday is a first check, and a likely delay should be reported early.

explanation.strategy: 分别核对人物职责、日期用途和延迟处理；出现了文中的名字或日期，不等于整句话正确。

steps.text: Ava负责询问作者许可；Rui只负责练习开场介绍。
steps.reason: 参与同一项目，不代表职责相同，也不能因为某个人负责朗读，就把所有任务都算给他。

steps.text: Tuesday是首次检查；核对修改并取得作者许可后才可分享。
steps.reason: 检查日不是承诺的公开发布日期。

steps.text: 预计延迟要提前告诉团队，方便共同调整。
steps.reason: 只有把分工、日程和条件都读对，组合表述才成立。

distractors.reason: 把Ava的许可工作转给了Rui，还把一项练读任务扩大成所有任务。
把首次检查当成强制公开发布，并跳过仍需核对的许可条件。

explanation.pitfall: 同一个项目里的多个人、多项日期或条件，要逐一对应，不能看见关键词就整项照收。

visual.title: 人、时间、条件分别对齐
visual.caption: 四格分别核对，不能把检查日期或一项职责扩大成发布承诺或全部工作。
